UNICORN HOP - a RetroStone VC game for Windows
(c) 2026 Pierre-Louis Boyer (8BCraft). Code MIT, art/music/sound CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: see LICENSE-unicornhop.txt.

A little unicorn climbs the sky from cloud to cloud. Press A and it jumps
straight up: time it so the cloud sliding above is under its hooves when it
comes down. Pink clouds bounce you two levels, grey rain clouds melt (hop off
quick!), grumpy thunder clouds zap. Catch the stars, reach a rainbow every 25
clouds, climb into the sunset, the night and the aurora. One miss and you fall:
medals at 10, 30, 60 and 120, and your best score is kept.

Run UnicornHop.exe. No installation needed (SDL2 is built in).

Controls                  Gamepad (SNES layout)      Keyboard
  jump, start               A (B, X, Y and Up too)     X, Up or Enter
                            Start starts               (Z, A and S too)
  pause / resume            Select (or Start in a run) Backspace or Esc
  players 2-4 join          A on their pad, on the title (B leaves)
  back to the title         A (or Select) on the results
  touch / mouse             a tap anywhere is A

Up to four players climb the same clouds, each with their own pad (white,
lilac, pink and mint unicorns). Stay with the leader: three clouds behind and
you are out. The results rank everyone by height, with medals.

F11 or Alt+Enter: fullscreen. F12: screenshot. Close the window to quit.
Options: UnicornHop.exe --scale 4 --fullscreen
The best score is saved in unicornhop.srm next to the exe.
